roadmap.title: Main story run
roadmap.description: Play the main story to the credits. Pick up the first-time achievements on the way: a first egg, the Rite of Channeling, crafting at the smith and the Catavan.

roadmap.title: Postgame cleanup
roadmap.description: After the credits, finish subquests, friend quests, the Rider Arena and collections, while grinding eggs, battles and money.

roadmap.title: Level 99, Tower and Labyrinth
roadmap.description: Grind a Monstie to level 99 in the Tower of Illusion, then beat the Tower and the Labyrinth and finish rare gear and the monster list.

achievements.description: In recognition of your departure from Hakum and arrival in Darj Snowfields. A new journey begins here.
achievements.summary: Leave Hakum and arrive in Darj Snowfields during the main story.

steps.text: Follow the main story from @loc{Hakum} until you reach @loc{Darj Snowfields}.

achievements.description: In recognition of your Gildegaran visit. A heavily guilded emblem.
achievements.summary: Visit Gildegaran during the main story.

steps.text: Follow the main story until you arrive in @loc{Gildegaran}.

achievements.description: In recognition of your Oasum visit. A gloriously autumnal bookmark.
achievements.summary: Visit Oasum during the main story.

steps.text: Follow the main story until you arrive in @loc{Oasum}.

achievements.description: In recognition of your Albarax visit. A dried twig symbolic of the village.
achievements.summary: Visit Albarax during the main story.

steps.text: Follow the main story until you arrive in @loc{Albarax}.

achievements.description: In recognition of your Geo-Fulkright visit. Minerals make many medals!
achievements.summary: Visit Geo-Fulkright during the main story.

steps.text: Follow the main story until you arrive in @loc{Geo-Fulkright}.

achievements.description: In recognition of your visit to Koapni. A purrfectly pelagic powerstone.
achievements.summary: Visit Koapni during the main story.

steps.text: Follow the main story until you arrive in @loc{Koapni}.

achievements.description: In recognition of completing the main story and revisiting Pondry Hills. Kinship lights the Rider's way.
achievements.summary: Finish the main story, then revisit Pondry Hills.

steps.text: Finish the main story.
After the credits, return to @loc{Pondry Hills}.

achievements.description: In recognition of completing at least one Subquest. Good job, but you've still got a long way to go!
achievements.summary: Complete one Subquest.

steps.text: Accept any subquest from a villager or the quest board and finish it.

achievements.description: In recognition of your completing at least 10 Subquests. Getting there, eh?
achievements.summary: Complete 10 Subquests.

steps.text: Keep taking subquests as you play until you have finished 10.

achievements.description: In recognition of your completing at least 100 Subquests. Better than all the rest!
achievements.summary: Complete 100 Subquests.

guide.context: Forging subquests from the smith count, but repeating quest board subquests does not. Quests that are easy to overlook: the cabins and hot spa up in Darj Snowfields, the scribes' hall at the guild, and the house where Reverto lives. Forging costs about 900,000z in total, so save for the Zenny-Pinching Pouch first.

steps.text: Talk to everyone in each town and check each building for subquests as you progress.
Do the forging subquests from the smith once you have 1,000,000z.

achievements.description: In recognition of completing the Debli Subquest and revisiting Koapni Village. Ya still don't boogie the Poogie!
achievements.summary: Complete Debli's subquest and revisit Koapni Village.

guide.context: Debli's quest starts after the second visit to Koapni Village in the main story.

steps.text: Talk to @npc{Debli} in @loc{Koapni Village} and take "Debli's Ambition".
Bring a Monstie that knows @mechanic{Ivy Climb} in your party.
Fast travel to @loc{Great Tree Root} in Aowa Valley, Naubaka Island. Climb the tree and win the fight.
Return to @loc{Koapni Village} to unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: In recognition of completing Avinia's Subquest and revisiting Koapni Village. Mucho mutual assistance. Nice!
achievements.summary: Complete Avinia's two subquests and revisit Koapni Village.

guide.context: Her quests start after the second visit to Koapni Village in the main story.

steps.text: Talk to @npc{Avinia} in @loc{Koapni Village}.
Hand over 1x @item{Purple Ludroth Scale} for the quest "Avinia's Memento 1".
Hand over 1x @item{Agnaktor Shell} and 1x @item{Emerald Congalala Claw} for "Avinia's Memento 2".
Return to @loc{Koapni Village} to unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: In recognition of completing Reverto's Subquest and revisiting Reverto's house. Learning the Hunter's way...
achievements.summary: Complete Reverto's subquest and revisit his house.

steps.text: Go to @npc{Reverto}'s house, next to the eastern exit of @loc{Gildegaran}, and take "Reverto's Teacher".
Beat the @enemy{Shrouded Nerscylla} in its subquest den, found in @loc{Trese Desert}.
Next, beat @enemy{Tigrex} in its subquest den, found in @loc{Monsonne Plains}.
Return to @npc{Reverto}.

achievements.description: In recognition of completing Simone's Subquest and revisiting the Scriveners. The endless pursuit of the unknown!
achievements.summary: Complete Simone's subquest and revisit the Scriveners.

guide.context: Simone's quest starts after the second visit to Mt. Pondry Cave in the main story.

steps.text: Find @npc{Simone} inside the Hall of Scriveners of the @loc{Gildegaran} guild building and start "Simone's Past".
Beat @enemy{Ruby Basarios} in its subquest den, found in @loc{Pondry Hills}.
Return to @npc{Simone}.

achievements.description: In recognition of completing The Channeler's Subquest and revisiting the Darj Mountain Cabins. A new Riddle Master!
achievements.summary: Complete all 9 subquests of The Channeler and revisit the Darj Mountain Cabins.

guide.context: The quests unlock through the game as your party can hold higher-rarity Monsties. The ninth only opens after the credits. Each asks you to hatch a specific Monstie and show it from your team.

steps.text: Travel to @loc{Darj Mountain Cabins} and speak with @npc{The Channeler}.

Complete the nine "Riddle Me This" quests, one Monstie each, in this order: @enemy{Apceros}, @enemy{Red Khezu}, @enemy{Nerscylla}, @enemy{Barroth}, @enemy{Uragaan}, @enemy{Yian Garuga}, @enemy{Congalala}, @enemy{Lagiacrus}, @enemy{Kirin}.
After the ninth quest, return to the @loc{Darj Mountain Cabins}.

achievements.description: In recognition of revisiting Albarax after fully restoring it. A leafy twig symbolic of the village.
achievements.summary: Finish the Oasis Revival subquest in Albarax and revisit it.

guide.context: This also opens the Rider Arena and the Grillhouse.

steps.text: After the Albarax main story section, talk to @npc{Chief Nolma} to get the subquest "Oasis Revival".
Deliver 15x @item{Iron Ore}.
Return to @loc{Albarax} to unlock the achievement.

achievements.description: In recognition of defeating the monster on the highest floor of The Tower of Illusion. You conquered the summit!
achievements.summary: Defeat the monster on the top floor of the Tower of Illusion.

guide.context: Only the Tower of Illusion counts; skip the other two towers. It has 50 floors. Floor 39 has two Kirin, and floor 49 has Ivory Lagiacrus and Rajang. Floor 50 is Silver Rathalos and Golden Rathian together, 8000 HP each.

steps.text: Finish the final main story mission. At @loc{Gildegaran}, take the harbour ship to the Tower.
Stock up on @item{Moxie Gem} and @item{Vital Essence} at the Koapni Village merchant. Offer a combat Charm at a @mechanic{Prayer Pot}.
Enter the middle door on floor 1 and climb the Tower of Illusion.
On floor 49, use @item{Shock Trap}s and an Ice Monstie against @enemy{Rajang}.
On floor 50, do not use Speed moves on @enemy{Golden Rathian}. Keep @item{Shock Trap}s ready for @enemy{Silver Rathalos}.

achievements.description: In recognition of defeating the boss of the Shadow Labyrinth. A-mazingly good!
achievements.summary: Defeat the final boss of the Labyrinth of Ordeals.

guide.context: The Labyrinth of Ordeals is a random dungeon of 5 areas. The last boss is either @enemy{Kushala Daora} or @enemy{Teostra}.

steps.text: Finish the final main story mission. Fast travel to @loc{Ruins of Redan} in Babda Rainforest, then take the east exit into the Labyrinth of Ordeals.
Offer a combat Charm at a @mechanic{Prayer Pot} before you start.
Beat the boss at the end of each of the first four areas.
In area 5, beat the final boss, @enemy{Kushala Daora} or @enemy{Teostra}.
Against @enemy{Teostra}, survive its Supernova with a @item{Moxie Gem} or the Tenacity skill. Deviljho's Vangis Armor gives the Rider Tenacity, and the Purple Gypceros gene gives it to a Monstie.

achievements.description: In recognition of saving at least 10 Barrel Felynes. Roll out the barrel...
achievements.summary: Save 10 Barrel Felynes in battle.

guide.context: A Barrel Felyne is saved by dealing about 50 damage before it flees on turn 1 or 2. They appear on every Tower of Illusion floor ending in 5.

steps.text: After the final story mission, take the harbour ship at @loc{Gildegaran} to the Tower.
Go to a Tower of Illusion floor ending in 5 and fight the @enemy{Barrel Felyne}.
Use @item{Big Barrel Bomb}, a Rathalos fire skill or the Sword & Shield @mechanic{Octaslash} skill.
Teleport out with a @item{Paw Pass Ticket} and repeat until 10 are saved.

achievements.description: In recognition of five consecutive Head-to-Head wins. Headbanger!
achievements.summary: Win five Head-to-Heads in a row.

guide.context: A Head-to-Head happens when attack types clash. Speed beats Power, Power beats Tech and Tech beats Speed. Tower of Illusion floor 2 monsters only use Power, and floor 3 monsters only use Speed.

steps.text: Use the attack type that beats the enemy's choice and win five clashes without losing one.

achievements.description: In recognition of executing a Double Attack. Keep up the great teamwork!
achievements.summary: Perform a Double Attack.

steps.text: Pick the same attack type as your Monstie against one enemy that uses a type weak to it: Speed against Power, Power against Tech, or Tech against Speed.

achievements.description: For executing at least 10 Kinship Skills successfully. United in victory.
achievements.summary: Use a Kinship Skill 10 times.

guide.context: The 10 uses can be the same skill with the same Monstie.

steps.text: In battle, fill the @mechanic{Kinship Gauge} and choose @mechanic{Ride}.
While riding, use the Kinship Skill. Repeat until you have used it 10 times.

achievements.description: In recognition of winning at least 500 battles. For those who seldom know defeat..
achievements.summary: Win 500 battles.

guide.context: Grinding to level 99 gets most of the way there.

steps.text: After the final story mission, take the harbour ship at @loc{Gildegaran} to the Tower.
Keep fighting battles, such as on Tower of Illusion floors 2 to 5, until you reach 500 wins.

achievements.description: For obtaining S Rank in at least 50 battles. A crest to commemorate your style.
achievements.summary: Earn S Rank in 50 battles.

guide.context: S Rank is 500 points. The Navirou Bonus gives 500 points. Winning with a Kinship Skill gives 300. Three Head-to-Head wins in a row give 150, and losing no Head-to-Head gives 100.

steps.text: Win battles using Kinship Skills and Head-to-Head wins until you have S Rank 50 times.

achievements.description: In recognition of hatching an egg. A broody seal for the mother in all of us.
achievements.summary: Hatch an egg.

steps.text: Hatch the egg during the main story.

achievements.description: For acquiring at least 50 eggs from Monster's Dens. Peerless in your pilfering.
achievements.summary: Take 50 eggs from Monster Dens.

guide.context: You can hold only 12 eggs, so hatch them often.

steps.text: Enter a monster den in the field and take an egg from the nest at the end, then leave.
Hatch your eggs at the @npc{Stable Paw} in any city to make room. Repeat until you have taken 50.

achievements.description: For performing the Rite of Channeling. Evidence of your excellent erudition.
achievements.summary: Perform the Rite of Channeling.

steps.text: Perform the Rite of Channeling during the main story.

achievements.description: For achieving bingo in the Rite of Channeling. Magnify those Monsties!
achievements.summary: Line up three genes of the same colour or symbol in the Rite of Channeling.

guide.context: This works in the normal rite and when you use Ritual Items.

steps.text: Open the @npc{Stable Paw} menu in a city and choose @mechanic{Rite of Channeling}.
Place 3 genes of the same colour or same symbol in a line.

achievements.description: For raising a Monstie to Level 99. Pushing limits to their, err, limits!
achievements.summary: Raise a Monstie to level 99.

guide.context: The fast route is Tower of Illusion floors 2 to 5. Floor 5 has a @enemy{Barrel Felyne} worth 50000 Exp. A Training Charm gives +50% Exp and a Training Charm+ gives +200%. Their timer does not run in battle or menus. You get Training Charm+ as a Monsterpedia gift for your first Molten Tigrex, or by finishing the special subquest "Fire in the Sky" once.

steps.text: After the final story mission, take the harbour ship at @loc{Gildegaran} to the Tower.
At a @mechanic{Prayer Pot} in a city, offer a @item{Training Charm} or @item{Training Charm+}.
Run Tower of Illusion floors 2 to 5, beat the @enemy{Barrel Felyne} on floor 5, then teleport out with a @item{Paw Pass Ticket}.
Repeat until a Monstie reaches level 99.

achievements.description: For making a Great Sword. Slice, slash, sever, stab.
achievements.summary: Craft a Great Sword.

guide.context: Smiths unlock after your first story visit to Gildegaran.

steps.text: Visit a smith, pick a Great Sword, defeat the monster it needs once or twice and craft it.

achievements.description: For making a Sword & Shield. Intense combos for your delectation.
achievements.summary: Craft a Sword & Shield.

steps.text: Visit a smith, pick a Sword & Shield, defeat the monster it needs and craft it.

achievements.description: For making a Hammer. Try its heavy strikes for—not on—yourself.
achievements.summary: Craft a Hammer.

steps.text: Visit a smith, pick a Hammer, defeat the monster it needs and craft it.

achievements.description: For making a Hunting Horn. Play yourself an itty bitty ditty.
achievements.summary: Craft a Hunting Horn.

steps.text: Visit a smith, pick a Hunting Horn, defeat the monster it needs and craft it.

achievements.description: For making a set of armor. Trust in it, you made it, after all...
achievements.summary: Craft one set of armor.

steps.text: Visit a smith, pick an armor set, defeat the monster it needs and craft it.

achievements.description: For acquiring a rarity 7 weapon or armor. A kingly achievement indeed!
achievements.summary: Get a rarity 7 weapon or armor.

guide.context: Weapons and armor reach rarity 7 once their original level is maxed and the credits have rolled. Crafting gear from a postgame-only monster is faster.

steps.text: Craft a weapon or armor from a postgame-exclusive monster, or upgrade gear to its maximum level.

achievements.description: For acquiring a rarity 8 accessory. A queenly achievement indeed.
achievements.summary: Get a rarity 8 accessory.

guide.context: This is a very rare drop. A manual save lets you retry without redoing the Labyrinth. If no accessory drops, go to the title screen and load the manual save, not the autosave.

steps.text: After the main story, put @enemy{Gravios} or @enemy{Uragaan} in your team for @mechanic{Lava Dive}. At a @mechanic{Prayer Pot}, offer a @item{Gathering Charm}.
In the Labyrinth of Ordeals, clear the first area and defeat the first boss.
In the lava @loc{Hidden Sanctuary}, make a manual save.
Enter the @loc{Flame Labyrinth} and loot every marked spot in its first room. If no rarity 8 accessory drops, reload the manual save and repeat.

achievements.description: For completing an egg from fragments. A golden egg of success.
achievements.summary: Complete an egg from egg fragments.

guide.context: You need one fragment of each of the 9 shapes. Pattern, genus and colour lines do not matter. Fragments come from rare orange or brown bone piles. A Gathering Charm makes them appear more, and riding Basarios or Uragaan gives Bone Search.

steps.text: Make a @item{Gathering Charm} offering at a @mechanic{Prayer Pot}, then search the northwest of @loc{Trese Desert} for rare bone piles.
Open the @npc{Stable Paw} menu in a city, then @mechanic{Egg Carton} and @mechanic{Egg Fragments}, and build the egg.

achievements.description: For acquiring a Ritual Item. Monstie power in crimson form.
achievements.summary: Get a Ritual Item.

guide.context: Ritual Items come from red and blue chests, Monsterpedia gifts and uncommon late-game monster drops.

steps.text: Open a red or blue chest, or claim a Monsterpedia gift for slaying a monster or hatching a Monstie.

achievements.description: For collecting all recipes. Proof of your mastery over all items.
achievements.summary: Collect every recipe in the game.

guide.context: Most recipes come from finishing every available subquest, including the cat's quest in Reverto's House and the quest in the Hall of Scriveners. The red treasure chests below hold the rest.

collectibles.location: Red treasure chest

collectibles.name: Recipe: Attack Jewel Lore
collectibles.location: Red treasure chest
collectibles.method: Easy to find.

achievements.description: For winning Bronze at the Rider Arena. Good, but it's not Silver...
achievements.summary: Win Bronze at the Rider Arena.

guide.context: The Rider Arena opens after Oasis Revival.

steps.text: Enter the Bronze tournament in the @loc{Rider Arena} and win.

achievements.description: For winning Silver at the Rider Arena. Good, but it's not Gold...
achievements.summary: Win Silver at the Rider Arena.

steps.text: Enter the Silver tournament in the @loc{Rider Arena} and win.

achievements.description: For winning Gold at the Rider Arena. Good, but it's not Platinum...
achievements.summary: Win Gold at the Rider Arena.

steps.text: Enter the Gold tournament in the @loc{Rider Arena} and win.

achievements.description: For winning Platinum at the Rider Arena. Now this really IS good!
achievements.summary: Win Platinum at the Rider Arena.

guide.context: This is postgame difficulty. A Sword & Shield with the Guard skill makes it easier. The enemy Rider has less health than the Monsties and cannot swap out, so target the Rider when you can.

steps.text: Enter the Platinum tournament in the @loc{Rider Arena}.
If your Monstie is about to hit a full-health enemy Monstie with one single-target attack, command a single-target or multi-target Skill at the enemy Rider instead.

achievements.description: For gathering items at least 100 times. The embodiment of insatiable curiosity.
achievements.summary: Gather items 100 times.

guide.context: Gather while riding your Monstie to skip the gathering animation.

steps.text: Gather items at gathering spots while riding until you have gathered 100 times.

achievements.description: For accumulating at least 1,000,000z. Next round of bumblepumpkins is on you!
achievements.summary: Hold 1,000,000z at the same time.

guide.context: You must hold the full amount at once. Do this before buying forging subquest gear.

steps.text: Make a @item{Selling Charm} offering at a @mechanic{Prayer Pot} in a city.
Sell your whole inventory until you hold 1,000,000z.

achievements.description: For an Awesome Expedition Party result. Illegible Monstie scribbles.
achievements.summary: Get an Awesome result from an Expedition Party.

guide.context: Chances are best with the Treasure hunt goal and five Monsties of the same element from the ones recommended for the chosen field.

steps.text: Open the @npc{Stable Paw} menu in a city and choose @mechanic{Expedition Party}.
Choose the Treasure hunt goal and send five Monsties of one element recommended for that field.

achievements.description: For riding the Catavan at least 10 times. A cap brimming with Catavaner pride.
achievements.summary: Ride the Catavan 10 times.

steps.text: Use the Catavan fast travel stands 10 times.

achievements.description: For a Great fishing result at least 10 times. See things from a different angle.
achievements.summary: Reel in 10 items while fishing.

guide.context: There is no separate Great result to aim for. Each catch counts.

steps.text: Fish at any fishing spot and reel in 10 items.
